subject: Request: Access inventory + SAML/SCIM artifacts for SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@healthops.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: security@healthops.com
Date: Sun, 16 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Access inventory + SAML/SCIM artifacts for SOC2 intake

Hi Naomi,

We're kicking off our vendor SOC 2 evidence intake for Q1 2026 and need a short packet from Redwood focusing on identity and access controls. Can you provide the following by next Tuesday (2025-11-18)?

- SCIM delta feed for the last 90 days (CSV) showing add/modify/delete with timestamps and actor if available
- A few sample SAML assertion payloads (redacted PII) that show NameID, attributes used for roles/groups, and audience/issuer fields
- Current RBAC role-to-permission mapping (spreadsheet) and a one-paragraph summary of how least-privilege is enforced when users are provisioned
- On-call escalation/approver roster for access changes (PDF)
- Preferred secure transfer method (SFTP, pre-signed S3, vendor portal)

Also note: we may ask for logs of admin console actions for the same 90-day window if the SOC auditor requests them. Let me know if that will be feasible.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation of scope and timeline.

Liam
Liam Chen
Security Operations | HealthOps Inc.
security@healthops.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@healthops.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 16 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access inventory + SAML/SCIM artifacts for SOC2 intake

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. We can produce everything you requested. Quick confirmations before we collect artifacts:

- Format for SCIM delta: we can provide CSV with columns (timestamp, op, user_id, attribute, old_value, new_value, actor_email). Is that acceptable?
- For SAML samples we will redact attributes that contain PII; we will provide three different assertion examples (SSO via Okta, SSO via Azure AD, and a sample SP-initiated flow)
- RBAC mapping: we'll export current role-permission matrix and include a short note on just-in-time role assignment and SCIM provisioning filters
- Admin action logs: we can provide an extract of console admin actions (create/update/delete user, change roles) for 90 days, but note these are paginated audit events and may be delivered as gzipped CSVs

We're looping in Aditya (security eng) for the exports and Karthik (onboarding PM) for the access-approval roster and process note. Would SFTP to the host you specify be preferred, or do you want a pre-signed S3 link?

Plan: Aditya will prepare the SCIM and SAML samples; Karthik will pull the role matrix and roster. Naomi to package and upload. We'll shoot to send an initial bundle by EOD Monday (2025-11-17).

Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@healthops.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access inventory + SAML/SCIM artifacts for SOC2 intake

Hi team — attaching the exports we discussed. Notes below and attached filenames: scim-delta-90days.csv, saml-assertion-samples.txt, role-permission-matrix.xlsx.

Technical notes (short):
- SCIM delta: we export from our provisioning service; timestamps are in UTC. 'actor_email' is populated for admin-driven changes; system-syncs show 'system@redwood.com'. We redacted user PII columns (email -> user_hash) per our data policy.
- SAML samples: assertion timestamps and session indices retained; NameID and attributes are shown but we removed any raw email addresses. Audience/Issuer and signature block preserved in sample text.
- RBAC model: roles are hierarchical; we enforce least privilege via onboarding filters + an approval workflow for role elevation that requires manager + security reviewer sign-off (ticketed in Jira). The attached matrix maps roles to coarse permission categories (read/write/admin) and surface services impacted.
- Admin logs: we can export 'console_admin_actions_90d.gz' but that's ~120MB — Naomi, confirm transfer method if you want that included now.

Attachment stubs: scim-delta-90days.csv (CSV, 1.2MB), saml-assertion-samples.txt (TXT, 45KB), role-permission-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 320KB)

Let me know if HealthOps needs different redaction or a signed statement for the samples.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@healthops.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: security@healthops.com
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access inventory + SAML/SCIM artifacts for SOC2 intake

Thanks Aditya — that format looks good. We prefer a pre-signed S3 link for the larger admin logs (console_admin_actions_90d.gz) and SFTP for smaller files is fine but presigned link is easiest for our auditor. I've created a temporary bucket and will send an upload URL below.

Presigned upload URL (expires in 72h): https://s3-presign.healthops.example/upload/6a7b8c9d

A couple of follow-ups:
- Auditor also wants evidence of access-change approvals: do you have a sample ticket showing manager + security reviewer approval (can redact user identifiers)?
- We need an on-call approver roster for provisioning changes for the past 6 months (PDF). Can you include who is the secondary approver when security is out?

If you can place everything to the S3 link by EOD Monday, that should keep us on schedule.

Liam

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@healthops.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access inventory + SAML/SCIM artifacts for SOC2 intake

Liam — thanks, we'll upload to the presigned S3 link. Delivery plan and artifacts:

1) Uploads to your S3 presigned URL by 2025-11-17 18:00 PST:
   - scim-delta-90days.csv (CSV, includes actor_email column where available)
   - saml-assertion-samples.txt (three examples, PII redacted)
   - role-permission-matrix.xlsx (current mapping)
   - oncall-roster.pdf (current roster + secondary approver)
   - console_admin_actions_90d.gz (audit export — large file)
   - sample-approval-ticket-redacted.pdf (manager + security reviewer signatures redacted)

2) Transfer notes: scim CSV uses UTC timestamps; we included a README.txt in the upload explaining column definitions and the redaction approach.

3) Related links: HubSpot ticket HS-987654 for vendor intake; shared Drive folder with internal processing notes: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfGHIjkLmNoP

If everything looks okay on your side, can you confirm receipt once the uploads complete? We'll hold on any further exports until your auditor asks for more.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
